ticks.note: Tick 1 enters both regions of both charts. `x` starts at 1.

Both old-style updates run in this tick, and KIELER runs them in the order the regions are written. `OldUpdates` runs `Add` first: (1 + 2) * 3 = 9. `OldUpdatesSwapped` runs `Triple` first: 1 * 3 + 2 = 5. The same two updates, two results.
Nothing else happens: 9 on one side, 5 on the other.
